items.stem: You are Diya of Indore. Write a letter in 120–150 words to the Municipal Commissioner complaining about stray animals being fed unhealthy junk food in the local market and suggesting remedies.
items.answer: A formal letter covering: the problem; harm to animals and people; suggestions (feeding points, awareness, vets); request for action.
items.markingKey: Format (1): sender's address, date, receiver's address, subject line, salutation, body in paragraphs, complimentary close (Yours faithfully/sincerely) and name. Content: purpose in the first paragraph, details, request or suggestion, polite close. Content (2 marks): the problem; harm to animals and people; suggestions (feeding points, awareness, vets); request for action. Expression (2 marks): fluency, accuracy of grammar and spelling, appropriate register and word limit.
